odvs.description: win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode is the policy setting configures the Brute-Force Protection feature in Microsoft Defender Antivirus. Brute-Force Protection can detect and block attempts to forcibly initiate sign-ins and sessions. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: Audit. Configuring this setting to Block also conforms to the benchmark. 1 = Audit, 2 = Block
odvs.name: remote_encryption_protection_mode

registry.path: SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Remediation\Behavioral Network Blocks\Brute Force Protection

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.10.43.11.1.1.2 | PATCH | Ensure Configure Remote Encryption Protection Mode is set to Enabled: Audit or higher"
  when: win25cis_rule_18_10_43_11_1_1_2
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_18.10.43.11.1.1.2
    - patch
    - defender
    - brute_force
    - NIST800-171_3.14.1
    - NIST800-171_3.14.5
    - NIST800-171_3.14.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-7
    - NIST800-53R5_SI-4
  block:
    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.1.2 | PATCH | Ensure Configure Remote Encryption Protection Mode is set to Enabled: Audit or higher | Set Registry Value"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode == 1 or
          win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode == 2
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Remediation\Behavioral Network Blocks\Brute Force Protection
        name: BruteForceProtectionConfiguredState
        data: "{{ win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.1.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure Remote Encryption Protection Mode is set to Enabled: Audit or highere | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode != 1
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode != 2
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid setting for win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode. Please review"
          - "the variable and make the necessary change to bring it into compliance. Acceptable: 1 (Audit), 2 (Block)."

    - name: "18.10.43.11.1.1.2 | AUDIT | Ensure Configure Remote Encryption Protection Mode is set to Enabled: Audit or higher | Warning Logged"
      when:
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode != 1
        - win25cis_remote_encryption_protection_mode != 2
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.10.43.11.1.1.2'
